title: Riverside rest stop from a "mallworld" that I found in real life
content: When I was in my teens I frequently dreamed I would drive to a place that was a rest stop on the side of the highway, in the middle of nowhere. There was a gravel road that led from the highway to a few concrete picnic benches under the highway bridge next to a river, with a limestone staircase that led to the riverbank. When I was on my honeymoon (roadtripping through Texas) I found this exact place. It gave me such a strong deja vu feeling and I somehow thought something important would happen here, but it was rather uneventful. 12 years later I feel myself drawn to return to this place. I feel a nostalgia like feeling when I think about it, as if it was once one of my favorite places. It makes me think maybe part of the mallworld experience is us recalling our past lives?
